_meta.description: Firms appointed on Lines 4 and 4A. 'tender_ids' link to tenders.json.

contractors.name: Reliance Infrastructure and Astaldi (JV)
contractors.role: Civil contractor, three packages: Wadala to Amar Mahal Junction, Gandhi Nagar to Sonapur, Kapurbawdi to Kasarvadavali
contractors.notes: Fined Rs 5 crore after the Mulund parapet collapse of 14 Feb 2026. Free Press Journal reports that work on its Mulund stretch passed to a subcontractor in 2022 because of delays.

contractors.name: Tata Projects and China Harbour Engineering Company (JV)
contractors.role: Civil contractor, two packages: Garodia Nagar to Surya Nagar, Mulund Fire Station to Majiwada

contractors.name: J Kumar Infraprojects
contractors.role: Civil contractor, Line 4A, Kasarvadavali to Gaimukh

contractors.name: SEW Infrastructure and Vishwa Samudra Engineering (JV)
Larsen & Toubro
contractors.role: Integrated systems (trains, signalling, telecom, platform screen doors, depot machinery), track, and power supply from Wadala to Cadbury Junction

contractors.name: Alstom
contractors.role: Trains (39 Metropolis, six cars each), signalling and depot equipment, as L&T's partner, with five years of maintenance

contractors.name: DB Engineering & Consulting, Louis Berger and Hill International (JV)
contractors.role: General consultant, Lines 4 and 4A, from 2017 until MMRDA ended its services on 18 Feb 2026

excluded_claims.claim: Ballastless track contracts CA-161 (Apurvakriti) and CA-168 (L&T), station finishing CA-194 (Eagle Infra) and CA-222 (Godrej & Boyce), power CA-236 (IRCON-Jakson), fare collection CA-237 (Aurionpro)
excluded_claims.reason: Listed by The Metro Rail Guy's Green Line page as lowest bidders or awards; the individual reports were not read yet. Railway Gazette (Oct 2026) says L&T executes the track and power packages, which may mean some of these changed hands.
